The '''Annual Jatzday Race''' was an annual event that took place in the [[Togatto Speedway/Legends|Togatto Speedway]], a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] arena that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an upstart faction from among Esseles' criminal families planned to [[Death/Legends|murder]] their family leaders during the Annual Jatzday Race.<ref name="CCW" />
